source.quote: declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.8775 per share, payable on July 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on July 7, 2026
Core earnings were $592 million, or $1.54 per share
The company's 2026-2030 plan funds $38-$41 billion of capex, representing a significant investment period over the next five years
Edison International expects strong rate base growth of approximately 7% through 2030
